build_and_source_binding: Accepted R24 report/map anchor A; actual R34 source_input and formatter-final 220 map anchor B, with exactly the four frozen R34 changed paths.
Explicit existing Cargo home is required; no runtime cache copy/move and only one new component target with sequential A then B builds.
Each metadata registry package must appear in its selected lock and the accepted runtime lock; checksums and normalized A/B feature/dependency graph are compared.
Both root release profiles use the six exact accepted declarations; effective inherited build controls remain an explicit responsibility of the future invocation adapter.
Actual native build logs and terminal receipts must close; A ELF is copied/fsynced before B first build submission, all timing on the same x230 Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC boot.
Current cell source-manifest identity must equal selected arm build, A original build, and B closed-pair build; both separate ELF identities are bound before any cell.
The unformatted source manifest is explicitly rejected by build materialization until a separate formatted revision is frozen.
complete_original_evidence: Six original jobs require exact job/nonce/request/witness, terminal publication, complete durable stdout/stderr, stdin, native read offsets/EOF/counts, zero timeout/truncation/error, and original key recovery.
Victim must finish through original cancellation with signal evidence and no normal job release; the five nonvictims use private release markers.
Each gate captured output is compared with the independently read finished receipt and original ready process identity.
original_owner_and_cleanup: Partial start failure retains all known original jobs, awaits every start task, skips measurement, then reconciles known IDs without replacement keys.
Every original gate JoinHandle is awaited after inner measurement errors; native cancel is neither timeout-dropped nor retried.
Both runtime owner guards are awaited; observation-pool startup failure still awaits an already-started direct guard.
All coordinator local SSH Popen handles remain in Remote.children; post-spawn identity setup failure does not hide a child. WNOWAIT observation precedes actual waitpid reap.
Owned-generation cleanup uses original Popen/pidfd authority. Unexpected descendant survivors are force-cleaned and still fail the cell; external absence never substitutes for original owner reap.
Unknown reap or effect remains failed/uncertain. TTL bounds private fixtures but never proves original terminal closure.
production_shared_DIRECT: The one Rust driver starts the original direct transport and uses public ssh::run_capture for all eight ordinary gates.
Original native::cancel for one existing durable job reaches the same process-wide DIRECT; no production cancellation code is copied into an alternate execution path.
Eight slow cancellation requests are not used to infer a ninth slot; original MAX_CANCEL_PUBLICATIONS remains outside this component claim.
remote_before_release_witness: The witness is the original remote job directory cancel-request.json read through independent SSH inspection, not controller process_cancel_intent.
Original CANCEL_CODE publishes/fsyncs this file only after frozen supervisor identity/UID validation; write precedes signalling, so publication alone is not terminal or complete signalling proof.
Controller monotonic inspection begin/end must finish before fixed dispatch+3s; B requires positive observation and A requires none.
Held request job_id/launch_nonce and raw SHA agree with the final original remote request; original valid ACK and complete terminal/output checks remain separately required.

Occupancy samples must both start and finish within the held window, cover the fixed interval without excess gaps, retain all eight original gate generations and positively witness the matching ninth cancel generation for B.
